entries.name: Win the Festival (Master Hunter key item)
entries.lastOpportunity: The Festival result
notes: If Zidane falls while someone outside your party is leading, you win nothing.

entries.name: Prize — Zidane wins: 5,000 Gil
entries.lastOpportunity: The Festival result (only one prize per playthrough)

entries.name: Prize — Freya wins: Coral Ring
entries.lastOpportunity: The Festival result (only one prize per playthrough)
notes: GameFAQs notes none of the three character prizes is missable by the end of the game; they can be obtained in other ways later.
The Coral Ring is very useful in the final Disc 1 boss fight.

entries.name: Prize — Vivi wins: Theater Ship Card
entries.lastOpportunity: The Festival result (only one prize per playthrough)
notes: The Vivi-win achievement exists only on Steam, PS4, Xbox and mobile, not on the Switch.

entries.name: Recruit a new companion in Qu's Marsh
entries.lastOpportunity: Before continuing the story (affects ATEs later)
notes: This character joins later anyway, but recruiting now gives you a fourth party member for the hard fights ahead. GameFAQs also notes several later ATEs need them in the party.

entries.name: Blue Magic: Frog Drop (eat Gigan Toad)
Blue Magic: Limit Glove (eat Axe Beak or Mandragora)
notes: Both sources name Axe Beak (Lindblum Plateau). GameFAQs also lists Mandragora near Chocobo’s Forest.

Blue Magic: Pumpkin Head (eat Hedgehog Pie or Ladybird)
Dig up Chocograph #1: Streamside
notes: Digging up a Chocograph and finding its treasure are separate entries.

entries.name: Dig up Chocograph #3: Uncultivated Land
notes: Its treasure can’t be reached until Disc 3 (airship, or the Mountain ability). The Chocograph log on the Progress screen has the details.

Jegged’s Chocograph page says this one can’t be “obtained” before Disc 3. In context that refers to the treasure; Fishy071, Red Scarlet, GameFAQs and the Final Fantasy Wiki all list the Chocograph itself as diggable in Chocobo’s Forest from the start.

entries.name: Dig up Chocograph #4: Healing Shore
notes: This entry used to be listed under Daines-horse Basin. It keeps its original ID so earlier ticks still count.

entries.name: Dig up Chocograph #5: Abandoned Beach

notes: A second piece becomes diggable here once Choco has Reef (see Daines-horse Basin).
The completed set isn’t usable until much later in the game.

entries.name: Moccha Coffee (key item)
notes: One of the rare coffees for a long sidequest that can’t be finished until much later.

entries.name: Bronze Vest
entries.lastOpportunity: Use the bells on the side doors before the large door
notes: GameFAQs warns that using the bells in the wrong order can lock you out of these side passages.

entries.name: Mythril Gloves
entries.lastOpportunity: Use the bells on the side doors before the large door
notes: Also a steal from Zaghnol during the Festival of the Hunt.

entries.name: Magus Hat
entries.lastOpportunity: Use the bells on the side doors before the large door
notes: Also a steal from Gizamaluke.

entries.name: Give Vivi’s Kupo Nut to Moguta (Bell Room)

entries.name: Healing Shore treasure (Reef ability)
notes: Sources name the beach differently ("Metalark Shores" in GameFAQs, "Esistern Coast" in Fishy071’s guide). All three place it on the coast west of Burmecia.

entries.name: Bird's-Eye Lagoon treasure
notes: Only the treasure needs Reef. The Chocograph itself can be dug up any time in Chocobo’s Forest.

entries.name: Small Beach treasure
notes: Only the treasure needs Reef. The Chocograph itself can be dug up any time in Chocobo’s Forest.

entries.name: Dig up Chocograph Piece 2 (needs Reef)
notes: The Final Fantasy Wiki lists Piece 2 as available after Reef, and GameFAQs (bover_87) says the first two pieces are found in the Forest. GameFAQs board players report two pieces from the Forest on Disc 1.

Fishy071’s and Red Scarlet’s guides show only one piece from the Forest on Disc 1, but their route digs everything before getting Reef. They then find the next piece in Chocobo’s Lagoon, which pieces can also come from.

entries.name: Cancer (Stellazzio coin)
entries.lastOpportunity: Collect now (GameFAQs and PSNProfiles: available later; Jegged: one-time)
notes: Each Stellazzio coin has exactly one location, so there is no other way to get Cancer.

GameFAQs’ Stellazzio list says none of the 13 coins are missable, even on Disc 4. The PSNProfiles treasure guide lists Cancer under Burmecia for Discs 1–4. Jegged lists Burmecia as a one-time area. The evidence favours “not missable”, but it hasn’t been confirmed in-game.

entries.name: Soft
entries.lastOpportunity: Collect now (PSNProfiles: available later; Jegged: one-time)
notes: Sources disagree. The PSNProfiles treasure guide lists this chest as collectable on Discs 1–4, and GameFAQs implies the city can be revisited. Jegged calls Burmecia a one-time area whose treasure is gone for good. No source says how you get back into the city later. Collect it now to be safe.

entries.name: Germinas Boots
entries.lastOpportunity: Before the floor collapses (it collapses if you run)
notes: Only this chest is lost if the floor falls. Germinas Boots also come from the Streamside Chocograph treasure.

entries.name: Stiltzkin's deal (333 Gil)
entries.lastOpportunity: While he is in the Vault, and at the latest before the final Disc 1 battle
notes: The items themselves are ordinary. What matters is the purchase: this is the first of eight Stiltzkin deals, and buying every one earns a Ribbon later in the game (GameFAQs and Jegged agree).
GameFAQs warns he often only stays briefly.

entries.name: Mognet: deliver Mogki's letter to Atla
entries.lastOpportunity: This visit; you need the Kupo Nut before Disc 1 ends
notes: Atla is still in Burmecia much later in the game (GameFAQs Mognet list), but the Kupo Nut is only useful if you get it now.

entries.name: Kupo Nut delivery: take Atla's nut to Moguta
entries.lastOpportunity: Before the final Disc 1 battle
notes: Jegged calls this “your only opportunity to deliver this particular nut”. GameFAQs explains that if you are still holding a nut, Moogles won’t give you another.
